purpose: Bounded qualification of free/public exact-identity source redundancy for current MULTIASSET_V2A SOURCE_RECOVERY_CANDIDATE gaps.
qualification_requirements: Source must be official, free/public, auditable and legally accessible without private credentials.
Exact asset identity must match the frozen V2A coin_id/symbol; ticker equality alone is insufficient.
Trading pair existence and requested historical window must be proven from the source itself; this preregistration does not assert availability.
Raw response bytes or immutable downloadable object must be preserved and SHA-256 hashed before normalization.
Manifest must record provider, endpoint, pair, request parameters, retrieval timestamp, raw hash and parser version.
Schema mapping and candle timestamp semantics/timezone must be explicit and deterministic.
Duplicate, missing-row, monotonic-time, OHLC and nonnegative-volume QA must pass fail-closed.
Coverage must satisfy the already-frozen V2A historical requirement; no threshold, cutoff, denominator or history-length rule may be changed by this batch.
No historical reconstruction from another token, renamed asset, derivative, wrapped representation or synthetic cross-rate is allowed.
Qualification data cannot count as prospective evidence and cannot seal the dataset by itself.
Any failed candidate remains a documented DATA_GAP and the next free/public candidate may be tested only under a new explicit qualification record or versioned extension.
